description: Export, orchestration, dependencies and documentation: export.py (write research-only scores to data/model/assoc_scores.parquet with model version/hash, and MODEL_CARD.md stating the PU caveat, licences, and research-only/never-overrides-rules intended use); run_all.py (one command running the full pipeline end-to-end on whatever deps are present, writing tables + figures to research/kg/figures/, printing a capability banner and explicit SKIPPED lines for GNN/structure/figures when deps are absent); requirements.txt (pinned); and METHODS.md, PROCESS.md, README.md. Depends on FEAT-001..003.
steps: Read research/kg/.agents/plan.md and context.json FIRST, plus prior FEAT findings.

Create research/kg/export.py (`[kg.export]` style): export_scores(scores, model_version, graph_hash, out='data/model/assoc_scores.parquet') with columns drug_id,cui,score,model_version,model_hash; and write_model_card(path='research/kg/MODEL_CARD.md', metrics, licences) stating: absent label entries are UNLABELED not negative (PU-learning); licences ClinPGx CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribute/share-alike/non-commercial), SIDER and TG-GATEs licences to be verified; intended use research only, never clinical, never overrides or sets a rule category; rat-data limitation for TG-GATEs. The engine must never read this file — only export writes it.

Create research/kg/run_all.py (`[kg.run]` style): main() runs build_graph -> splits -> metrics -> baselines -> (gnn only if torch importable) -> ablations -> error_analysis -> export, writing tables (CSV/Parquet/Markdown) always and PNG figures to research/kg/figures/ only when matplotlib is importable. Print a capability banner at start (which optional deps present/absent) and explicit lines like 'SKIPPED: GNN (torch not installed)', 'SKIPPED: structure (RDKit not installed)', 'SKIPPED: figures (matplotlib not installed)'.

Create research/kg/requirements.txt pinning torch, torch-geometric, scikit-learn, pandas, pyarrow, numpy, scipy, duckdb, optional rdkit, optional matplotlib with versions, plus comments on the separate PyG wheel install step and the CPU-only torch index URL.

Write research/kg/METHODS.md (task definition, graph schema, why cold-start splits, baselines + GNN described precisely, PU-learning caveat, metrics + CIs, ablation design, honest limitations: SIDER 4.1 snapshot, labels from drug labels not patient outcomes, no patient cohort, rat TG-GATEs data; use [cite: verify] placeholders, invent NO citations); research/kg/PROCESS.md (PowerShell run guide: venv create, pip install -r requirements.txt, separate PyG wheel step, CPU-only torch path, where PubChem data goes (data_raw/pubchem/), what each command does, expected outputs, what to do when torch/RDKit absent); research/kg/README.md (short orientation, the one command `python run_all.py`, pointers to METHODS.md and PROCESS.md and MODEL_CARD.md).
acceptance_criteria: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/run_all.py completes end-to-end on the classical venv, prints the capability banner and explicit SKIPPED lines for GNN and structure (and figures if matplotlib absent), and still produces baseline tables + data/model/assoc_scores.parquet.
research/kg/MODEL_CARD.md contains the PU caveat, the three licences, and an explicit 'research only / never overrides rules' statement.

METHODS.md uses [cite: verify] placeholders and invents no citations; PROCESS.md documents the venv + PyG wheel + torch CPU-only steps and the torch/RDKit-absent fallback; README.md names the single run command.
requirements.txt pins all core deps with versions and notes the separate PyG install step.
verification: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/run_all.py  (expect end-to-end completion with SKIPPED banner lines and assoc_scores.parquet written)
research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest research/kg/tests/test_export.py  (fallback: run directly) — asserts the Parquet schema and the model-card required statements
findings:
DONE & verified on the classical venv (python 3.13.4; no torch/RDKit/matplotlib). Created research/kg/export.py, run_all.py, requirements.txt, METHODS.md, PROCESS.md, README.md, tests/test_export.py; MODEL_CARD.md is written by export.py (not committed as a static file is still committed since it is a doc artifact). Added data/model/ to .gitignore (generated research-only output, like artifacts/ and figures/).

VERIFICATION: (1) research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/run_all.py -> exit 0, completed end-to-end. Printed the CAPABILITY BANNER (torch/rdkit/structure_fingerprints/matplotlib all ABSENT) and the explicit lines 'SKIPPED: GNN (torch not installed)', 'SKIPPED: structure (RDKit not installed)', 'SKIPPED: figures (matplotlib not installed)'. Ablation matrix wrote 45 rows (35 ok, 10 skipped: 'graph' + '+structure' x5 seeds). Wrote data/model/assoc_scores.parquet (140677 rows, columns EXACTLY drug_id,cui,score,model_version,model_hash) and regenerated research/kg/MODEL_CARD.md. (2) pytest research/kg/tests/test_export.py -> 3 passed (schema exact 5 cols; model_hash order-independent + score-sensitive; card contains PU caveat, the 3 licences ClinPGx CC BY-SA/SIDER/TG-GATEs, 'research only'/'never overrides'/'rule category', and the rat-data limitation). (3) Full suite pytest research/kg/tests -> 29 passed in ~162s (benign sklearn ConvergenceWarning on logreg, expected per FEAT-003).

API: export.export_scores(scores, model_version, graph_hash, out='data/model/assoc_scores.parquet') -> (out_path, model_hash_hex). `scores` accepts a DataFrame (drug_id,cui,score) or an iterable of triples; writes columns drug_id,cui,score,model_version,model_hash. model_hash column = sha256(model_version|graph_hash|content_hash) where content_hash = model_hash(df) over sorted (drug_id,cui,rounded-score) rows (order-independent). export.write_model_card(path='research/kg/MODEL_CARD.md', metrics=None, licences=None) -> path; metrics dict is rendered under a Metrics section; licences dict can override the 3 default licence strings. export.main() scores every positive pair with the term-popularity baseline (runnable standalone). export._graph_hash() hashes artifacts/provenance.json (first 16 hex) or 'unknown'.

run_all.main() order: build_graph -> splits+metrics+baselines (matrix_factorisation_v1 is the headline export model; AUROC w/ 95% bootstrap CI over held-out drugs, n_boot=200 for speed) -> GNN (skipped w/o torch) -> ablations (n_boot=200) -> error_analysis (scores row-aligned from the export frame) -> figures (skipped w/o matplotlib) -> export + regenerate MODEL_CARD with this run's headline metric. Capability detection via _torch_available/_rdkit_available/_matplotlib_available/_structure_available. All sibling modules imported via sys.path.insert(THIS_DIR) (same convention as the other modules/tests).

ENGINE SEPARATION: assoc_scores.parquet is RESEARCH ONLY; export prints that the engine must never read it; nothing under engine/ or frontend/ references data/model/. Did NOT modify engine/, frontend/, research/models/. METHODS.md uses only [cite: verify] placeholders (no invented citations). requirements.txt pins the 6 core deps (numpy/pandas/pyarrow/scikit-learn/scipy/duckdb at the installed versions), lists optional matplotlib/rdkit, and documents the SEPARATE two-step PyG wheel install + CPU-only torch --index-url. PROCESS.md documents venv create, pip install -r, the PyG wheel + CPU-only torch steps, PubChem data location (data_raw/pubchem/), and the torch/RDKit/matplotlib-absent fallback. README.md names the single command `python run_all.py`. NOTE: did not perform plan.md step 11 (mirror to genomex-final/ml-package/kg/) as it is outside FEAT-004's listed deliverables.
